proof:
change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) (y : M7.Action.Recipe N), M7.CanonicalClasses.Normalized bases → y ∉ M7.OrbitResidual.covered bases → M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical y ∉ bases
